dedupe_keys.name: attest t4 2 tool for ancillary services activation in real time operation of the distribution network

description: Karlo Šepetanc, Mirna Gržanić and Tomislav Capuder at ICENT publish the ATTEST T4.2 tool for activating distribution-system flexibility in real time. It computes upward and downward activation for each device and writes decisions to an Excel workbook. Inputs include a MATPOWER network, PV production, expected device states, state-estimation results and activation requested from the transmission system. The October 2023 Zenodo archive is free under EUPL 1.2. Repository documentation specifies a batch-script entry point, Julia with PowerModels, DataFrames and XLSX, and AMPL with Ipopt. Those dependencies have separate installation and licensing requirements. Geographic coverage and time resolution depend on the configured network and current period. The tool supports ancillary-service and network-operation simulations. It consumes outputs from the related ATTEST tasks 4.1, 4.3 and 4.5, which must be supplied or replicated. No catalogue parent explicitly includes this implementation. Execution and optimisation feasibility remain unknown because the software was not run.
